language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, my name is Chip!
This is Nina and her family.
Nina’s family are camping on the beach for their vacation.
When we are on vacation together, we try to do many activities together.
There is lots to do on the beach!
My mom said at 10 o’clock we will be swimming and snorkeling
My watch looks like this. This is a digital watch.
My mom and dad each have an analogue watch
Your job is to help Nina tell the time on an analogue watch and a digital watch.
Let’s read this analogue watch first.
The small blue hand here is the hour hand. It is pointing to the 10.
This larger red hand here is the minute hand. It is pointing to the 12. The watch tells us it is 10 o’clock.
So, reading the time has two parts:
the number that the small hand points to is the first part of telling time, the hour.
The second part is the long hand and shows the minutes.
There are 60 minutes in one hour.
You can’t see the numbers, so you have to guess a little.
